title: BioNexus Scientific Semantic Conventions
description: A shared vocabulary for exchanging the meaning and evidence boundary of scientific AI outputs. This development release is a convention contract, not a claim of community adoption or biological validation.

biological.unit.brief: Biological or acquisition unit represented by the record.

matrix.state.brief: Mathematical state of the expression matrix consumed or produced.
matrix.state.note: Values describe representation, not quality. normalized_counts and log_normalized are intentionally distinct; normalized_expression is not accepted because it is ambiguous between them.

claim.type.brief: Strongest scientific proposition asserted by the record.

evidence.type.brief: Independently identifiable evidence classes actually present.

confound.type.brief: Alternative explanations explicitly assessed or left unresolved.

warrant.level.brief: Ordered positive support ceiling for the scientific claim.

warrant.status.brief: Orthogonal assessment state that must not be collapsed into warrant strength.

scientific.observation.brief: One claim-bearing scientific observation exchanged between tools.

scientific.dataset.brief: A dataset or matrix resource described without asserting a finding.

scientific.claim.brief: A claim and its evidence boundary when no matrix resource is exchanged.

matrix.state.normalized_expression: Ambiguous legacy value: declare normalized_counts or log_normalized explicitly. BioNexus will not infer whether a transform was logged.
